entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Just need the shipping label.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Got it, VF-8675309. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-V Pro helmet. Looks like that was delivered about 79 days ago. Let me just double-check the policy for you.
Look, I don't have all day. Is it returnable or not?

Yes, it is. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that window. Before I process this, can I ask what the issue was with the helmet? Was it the color, or a concern about safety features?
Neither. The box is unopened. I just decided to go with a different brand. The color is fine, I just don't need it.

I understand completely. We prioritize your satisfaction and safety, and since the box is unopened, this is very straightforward. I have processed the return for you. A pre-paid shipping label has just been sent to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
